categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Has the Mempool label and modifies mempool eviction handling in `src/validation.cpp` (`MaybeUpdateMempoolForReorg`) and mempool BIP68 tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where valid BIP68 transactions and all their descendants are incorrectly evicted from the mempool after reorgs that lower the chain tip or median time past. The PR addresses #35007 by recalculating stale lockpoints against the new tip in `MaybeUpdateMempoolForReorg` rather than immediately evicting on sequence-lock failure.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Excluded by category guidelines: PRs whose primary subject is mempool policy or mempool maintenance belong in mempool even when touching `src/validation.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Does not change consensus or chainstate validation logic; the changes in `src/validation.cpp` exclusively manage mempool eviction and lockpoint recalculation on reorgs.
